messages:
Rae (PM): we should run a short DP onboarding activation experiment next week. goal: increase "first useful inference" rate within 7 days by ~30% with minimal dev work.
Diego (Eng): what counts as first useful inference? hosted = API call + schema pass. private = deployment health + sample inference. segment both.
Tara (CS): agree. use an example probe intent rather than exact text match to avoid flakiness.
Nina (DevEx): plan: one-click Quickstart in Console, a lightweight checklist modal, and a single-question survey after success.
Li (Data): event surface: signup, quickstart_clicked, auth_failed, probe_passed, survey_response. need cohort tag dp=true and variant id.
Rae (PM): variants: A=control, B=personalized snippets by stack (Node/Python), C=auth-adaptive immediate nudge on auth_failed.
Diego (Eng): estimate: events + quickstart + modal = 3 dev-days. auth detection + immediate nudge = 1 more day. Feature-flag rollout.
Nina (DevEx): dashboard: funnel view signup->quickstart->probe_passed->survey. ETA 4 days.
Li (Data): metrics: primary = % probe_passed within 7 days. secondary = median time-to-success, survey score, support ticket rate within 30 days. target +30% primary, -30% auth tickets.
Rae (PM): launch gates: either statistically significant uplift (p<0.05) or auth tickets drop 40% and time-to-success improves. also no cost/latency regressions.
Tara (CS): I'll draft invite copy highlighting 10-min setup and optional SE office hour. be transparent.
DeployBot: experiment "dp_onboard_activation_v1" created. CI green.
Rae (PM): actions: Diego send event schema; Nina build quickstart; Li prepare analysis spec; Tara draft copy. reconvene Fri 9:30 for preflight.
